# dbm 0.1.0

The first public release provides an interactive Bun CLI and a BB Databases plugin for local Docker databases.

## Install

```sh
bun add --global @celeroncoder/dbm
dbm doctor
dbm
```

Install the BB plugin collection from the same immutable tag:

```sh
bb plugin install git:https://github.com/celeroncoder/dbm.git@0.1.0 --plugin dbm --yes
bb dbm images
```

## Supported managed images

- PostgreSQL: `postgres:16-alpine`
- MySQL: `mysql:8.4`
- Redis: `redis:7-alpine`
- MongoDB: `mongo:7`

The CLI can also discover common compatible images, including MariaDB, Valkey, PostGIS, and pgvector, when their native database client and expected environment conventions are available.

## Compatibility and known limits

- Bun 1.4 or newer
- Docker Engine reachable from Linux or macOS
- BB 0.39 or newer for the plugin
- Windows is unsupported; WSL2 is experimental
- Local trusted-development use only; remote and production database management are out of scope

The release includes the npm tarball, SHA-256 checksums, and an SPDX JSON SBOM. The npm publication uses registry provenance.

Uninstall with `bun remove --global @celeroncoder/dbm`. See the repository changelog and troubleshooting guide for details.
